name: Zoho CRM
label: Zoho CRM — REST API v8 (Zoho-oauthtoken, DC hosts)
description: Official Zoho CRM REST API v8 at https://www.zohoapis.com/crm/v8 (US default). Handler: OfficialApiNode. Auth header Authorization: Zoho-oauthtoken {access_token} (not RFC 6750 Bearer). Pick api_host from the token api_domain hostname (US/EU/IN/AU/CN/JP/CA; SA accounts at accounts.zoho.sa). Records are PII. Customer owns the Zoho CRM org. Minimize; never log access_token or field values. trigger.listen is BPMN message-event ingress. Docs: https://www.zoho.com/crm/developer/docs/api/v8/
author: 5c8b0d45-1d10-4f2e-844c-2318af96b2fa

ports.name: input
ports.description: Per-operation fields. Create/upsert/update bodies go in data as Zoho {data: [...]} . id for get/update/delete. Do not put access_token here. Example: {"operation":"contact.list","fields":"Last_Name,Email","per_page":"20"}.

schema.label: operation
schema.description: Overrides config operation when non-blank. EXACT catalog verbs: module.create | .upsert | .get | .list | .update | .delete (quote/salesOrder/purchaseOrder have no upsert), plus lead.fields and trigger.listen.

schema.label: id
schema.description: Record id for get/update/delete.

schema.label: data
schema.description: One Zoho record object escape hatch merged into data[0] on create/upsert/update. Named Last_Name/Email/Company/… win. Custom module fields stay here. Example: {"Last_Name":"Ada","Email":"ada@example.com","Custom_Field":"x"}.

schema.label: fields
schema.description: Comma-separated API field names for list/get.

schema.label: page
schema.description: List page.

schema.label: per_page
schema.description: List page size (Zoho max 200).

schema.label: ids
schema.description: Comma-separated record ids filter.

schema.label: cvid
schema.description: Custom view id for list.

schema.label: sort_by
schema.description: List sort field.

schema.label: sort_order
schema.description: asc | desc.

schema.label: duplicate_check_fields
schema.description: upsert duplicate-check field names as documented.

schema.label: module
schema.description: lead.fields: Zoho module API name. Example: Leads.

schema.label: trigger
schema.description: Request-body parameter `trigger` for operations: account.create, account.upsert, account.update, contact.create, contact.upsert, contact.update, deal.create, deal.upsert, deal.update, lead.create, lead.upsert, lead.update, product.create, product.upsert, product.update, invoice.create, invoice.upsert, invoice.update, quote.create, quote.update, salesOrder.create, salesOrder.update, purchaseOrder.create, purchaseOrder.update, vendor.create, vendor.upsert, vendor.update.

schema.label: Last_Name
schema.description: Contacts/Leads Last_Name. Wired to data[0].Last_Name. Required on contact/lead create/upsert.

schema.label: First_Name
schema.description: First_Name. Wired to data[0].First_Name.

schema.label: Email
schema.description: Email. Wired to data[0].Email. Example: ada@example.com.

schema.label: Phone
schema.description: Phone. Wired to data[0].Phone.

schema.label: Account_Name
schema.description: Accounts Account_Name. Wired to data[0].Account_Name. Required on account create/upsert.

schema.label: Description
schema.description: Description. Wired to data[0].Description.

schema.label: Quoted_Items
schema.description: Mandatory Quote line-item subform for quote.create. Array of line items. Example: [{"Product_Name":"P1","Quantity":1}].

schema.label: Invoiced_Items
schema.description: Mandatory Invoice line-item subform for invoice.create.

schema.label: Ordered_Items
schema.description: Mandatory Sales Order line-item subform for salesOrder.create.

schema.label: Purchased_Items
schema.description: Mandatory Purchase Order line-item subform for purchaseOrder.create.

schema.label: Pipeline
schema.description: Deal pipeline name/id for deal.create when pipelines enabled.

ports.name: output
ports.description: Success: status=ok, http_status, data (provider JSON). Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.

schema.label: status
schema.description: Exact 'ok' on HTTP 2xx.

schema.label: http_status
schema.description: Upstream status code.

schema.label: data
schema.description: Provider JSON. May contain PII — never log values.

configurationParameters.label: Operation
configurationParameters.description: Default operation when input.operation is blank. EXACT: account.create | account.upsert | account.get | account.list | account.update | account.delete | contact.create | contact.upsert | contact.get | contact.list | contact.update | contact.delete | deal.create | deal.upsert | deal.get | deal.list | deal.update | deal.delete | lead.create | lead.upsert | lead.get | lead.list | lead.update | lead.delete | lead.fields | product.create | product.upsert | product.get | product.list | product.update | product.delete | invoice.create | invoice.upsert | invoice.get | invoice.list | invoice.update | invoice.delete | quote.create | quote.get | quote.list | quote.update | quote.delete | salesOrder.create | salesOrder.get | salesOrder.list | salesOrder.update | salesOrder.delete | purchaseOrder.create | purchaseOrder.get | purchaseOrder.list | purchaseOrder.update | purchaseOrder.delete | vendor.create | vendor.upsert | vendor.get | vendor.list | vendor.update | vendor.delete | trigger.listen. trigger.listen is ingress. Pick api_host for the org DC.

configurationParameters.label: Access token
configurationParameters.description: Zoho OAuth 2 access token (StudioQuack secret). Sent as Authorization: Zoho-oauthtoken {token}. Refresh outside this node (~1h). Never log or place on INPUT.

configurationParameters.label: API host
configurationParameters.description: Hostname only (no scheme), from the token api_domain. US www.zohoapis.com · EU www.zohoapis.eu · IN www.zohoapis.in · AU www.zohoapis.com.au · CN www.zohoapis.com.cn · JP www.zohoapis.jp · CA www.zohoapis.ca. SA OAuth is accounts.zoho.sa — use that token's api_domain host. Must match the token DC.
